name: select-check-monorepo
description: SelectCheck — Cross-platform floating grammar & rewrite assistant (Tauri v2 + Cloudflare Workers Hono)

scripts.run:ios: xcodebuild -project apps/mobile/src-tauri/gen/apple/select-check-mobile.xcodeproj -scheme select-check-mobile_iOS -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -configuration debug CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY='' CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS='' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -derivedDataPath /tmp/selectcheck-ios build && xcrun simctl install booted /tmp/selectcheck-ios/Build/Products/debug-iphonesimulator/SelectCheck.app && xcrun simctl launch booted com.selectcheck.mobile
